referees.quote: While I fully recognize that this is the first report of S2CC in NdNiO3 across its phase transition, due to the above considerations I do not see this manuscript significant enough for Nature Communications.
it would be important to present reciprocal space map measurements... If these revisions cannot be made, I would recommend this publication be sent out to a more specialized journal.
the article lacks a neat result and is rather descriptive in nature. We believe that a deeper analysis of the experimental results is necessary in order to claim an important, novel result
I co-reviewed this manuscript with one of the reviewers who provided the listed reports.

note: There is no sign of a transfer from another journal; Version 0 is treated as the first round. R1 gave no formal verdict, but the 'not significant enough for Nature Communications' statement is read as reject. R3's report was an attached file (pages 37-38). R4 only states that they co-reviewed with one of the other referees. R4 is given R3's recommendation because the authors' rebuttal answers the attached R3 report under the Reviewer #4 heading, and that report uses 'we/us'. R5 did not take part in the first round: they joined at Version 2 and asked for revision with moderated claims. R5 is therefore not listed.
